topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, would you look at that. Beating the rain on the window, I’m flipping through the messages, and there it is. An old handle, familiar threads—someone from theojis, now just a street over. Small world, they say, but it don’t get much smaller than this. We’ve chatted, laughed, and swapped tales over the miles, now turns out, we share the same skyline. Maybe it’s time to take this talk from the keyboard to the coffee shop. Ain’t no coincidence, just a good kind of surprise in a city where you can go a lifetime without seeing the same face twice.
